strategy.name: Cornerbreaker
strategy.rationale: I watch which square of the floor you live in, and I slam that square.

observations: The player lived mostly on the right side of the arena: cell 31 at x≈750, y≈350 for 18.6% of the round, plus cell 54 at x≈650, y≈650 for 13.5% and cell 30 at x≈650, y≈350 for 10.3%.
They never took damage in 909 ticks, and the first boss hit landed only at tick 36.
They dashed only 6 times, with 4 of 6 dashes (67%) going east and 2 of 6 (33%) southeast, so their movement was sparse and strongly rightward.

They punished burst and spawn heavily, firing 104 shots during burst and 16 during spawn, but only 25 during slam and 0 during charge; the first slam at tick 1 was answered by a shot immediately, and the later slam at tick 41 missed.
The evidence fits a cautious camper/kiter hybrid more than a brawler: they held the right edge, waited out pressure, and shot most aggressively in non-slam windows.
analysis.counterPlan: Put pressure on the right half of the arena, especially around x=650–800 and y=300–700, because that is where they spent most of the round. Lean on slam and move to keep them from settling into that right-edge lane, but vary the landing square so they cannot prefire the same safe window. Use burst to punish their habit of unloading during burst phases, and spawn minions to block the x≈750,y≈350 perch and force a reposition before the next shot cycle.
